## Obsidian Callouts
> [!note] Important Physics Principle
> Energy equals mass times the speed of light squared.

> [!warning] Relativity Constraint
> No physical object with mass can accelerate to the speed of light.

> [!tip] Quantum Insight
> Photons have zero rest mass and always travel at c in vacuum.
